rows.en: Hooold it right there!!
We made it...!
We made it...!
Wait!!
Hooold it right there!!
...Wh-what?
We made it within the time limit, right?
...Hrrm.
(Never thought they'd make it in time... Then I'll just have to dispose of them in the finals...!!)
Of course. It violates none of the Regis Fight tournament rules...
The 8th team, arriving just under the time limit: the Hero Team!!
With this, the finalists are all assembled!!
All who triumphed in Survival Eleven so splendidly! First, let me say congratulations!
"Woooooooaaah~~~!!"
And now I declare the finals of the 1st Regis Fight open!!
"Woooooooaaah~~~!!"
Now then, you shall proceed to the ring set up inside the Plasma Spark Tower!
The first-round matchups are as follows.
Violence Dopant VS Alien Reflect!!
"Ooooooh~!"
Masurao VS Zamsha!!
"Woooooooaaah~!!"
Walter Gundam VS Pandon!! And finally...
"Woooooooaaaaaah~~!!"
Uva VS the Hero Team!!
"WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAH~~!!!!"
Now, finalists!! Into the tower!!
Yo! So the last team was you guys!
I was sure that Gaoh guy was gonna show up...
From what I heard, he never even entered the tournament!
...Gaoh? You're sayin' THAT Gaoh is here!?
Yeah! In this world, he's the boss of a famous gang of robbers, y'know?
Word is, he only goes after the strongest-class items.
Rumor has it he recently got his hands on the "Xtreme Memory."
What...!!
The Xtreme Memory... I'd sure love to use that thing at least once!!
If he's after the strongest-class stuff, he's probably got my Core Medals too...
Dammit!! I'll nab that guy and take it all back!!
Hahaha!! No can do. He sends everything he steals on to the Cubes up ahead.
The Cubes up ahead...?
Whoops, that's enough chitchat.
Well, my match is about to start, so I'm off.
Yo, Hero Team! Didn't figure the last team would be you lot!
I was sure that Gaoh guy was gonna show up...
From what I heard, he never even entered the tournament!
...Who's that?
What, you don't know Gaoh? In this world, he's the boss of a famous gang of robbers, y'know?
Word is, he only goes after the strongest-class items.
Rumor has it he recently got his hands on the "Xtreme Memory."
What...!!
The Xtreme Memory... I'd sure love to use that thing at least once!!
If he's after the strongest-class stuff, he's probably got my Core Medals too...
Hey! Where is this guy!? I'll catch him and take them back!!
Hahaha!! No can do. He sends everything he steals on to the Cubes up ahead.
The Cubes up ahead...?
Whoops, that's enough chitchat.
This is the venue for the Violence Dopant VS Alien Reflect match.
Your venue isn't here!
This is the venue for the Masurao VS Zamsha match.
Your venue isn't here!
This is the venue for the Walter Gundam VS Pandon match.
Your venue isn't here!
You're the Hero Team? The match is about to begin.
Your opponent, Uva, is already standing by. Are you lot ready for the match?
Good! Get inside!
There's no time. Hurry up, finish your preparations and come back!
How long are you gonna keep me waiting!?
So you've still got that Yummy tagging along.
What of it?
Stronger... I must get stronger...
This guy's so itching for a fight, I can barely hold him back.
Now, let the match begin...!!
Ugh... Uoooh...!!
What's wrong!?
Wooooooaaaaaaaargh...!!
...Haah... Haah... Destroy... Wreck... everything...!!
The Yummy split apart...!?
Hahahahahaha!! Now I've got one more piece on the board!!

notes.note: Tail of the party-leader 'Wait!' block started in story_081 (#0.21-0.34); each variant voiced from its wording. Long 'chotto matta' = 'Hooold it right there!!', short 'matta' = 'Wait!!', 'kita zo' = 'We made it...!' (they burst in at the deadline).
Countdown display left as digits; matches the 00:00:10... format of story_081.
Ankh asking Master Gundam; subject 'we' restored.
Master Gundam answering Ankh aloud; 'it' = their on-time arrival. Source has no quotes around the tournament name here, so none added.
Crowd cheers in double quotes, as in story_070. Cheer length scaled to the source's (#0.56 is the longest, in caps).
'Soshite...' rendered 'And finally...' since it introduces the last pairing.

0445 has two leader-variant blocks: #0.1-0.16 is the Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros) variant, #0.18-0.31 the Ankh variant. Identical Japanese got identical English across both blocks (minor comma/kanji differences ignored).
Extreme Memory rendered with the franchise's English spelling 'Xtreme Memory' (Kamen Rider W). Not in glossary.
Unlabelled; assigned to W (Shotaro) from the rough masculine wording and the preceding W (Shotaro) line. Same for #0.26.
Momotaros: object of 'take back' is unstated; 'take it all back' = whatever Gaoh stole (incl. the medals Ankh just mentioned).
'saki no Cube' read as the Cubes further along the heroes' route ('up ahead'); plural chosen since it is unspecific.
Unlabelled; Violence Dopant (same line is labelled at #0.31).
Unlabelled; Masquerade Dopant continues from #0.1. #0.5 likewise.
Kabuto Yummy's craving to grow stronger; rendered 'I must get stronger' (subject restored).

Unlabelled #0.19, #0.21, #0.22: Kabuto Yummy going berserk; #0.20 'What's wrong!?' = Uva to his Yummy (could also be a hero). #0.24 unlabelled hero-side line (likely OOO/Ankh). #0.25 = Uva, gloating that the split gives him an extra pawn.

report: All 80 rows translated. Unlabelled speakers inferred: 0445 #0.10/#0.26 (W Shotaro), #0.15 (Violence Dopant), 0449 #0.2/#0.5 (Masquerade Dopant), #0.19-0.22 (Kabuto Yummy/Uva), #0.24 (hero side). Not in glossary: Xtreme Memory (franchise English spelling).
